data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to read device screen corner radii on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides the per‑corner radius of the active screen, including live updates on multi‑screen devices. It uses native APIs on Android 12+ and iOS 26+, falling back to a bundled JSON dataset for older versions.
use_when: You need to match UI elements to the device’s rounded corners
You’re building a multi‑screen app that must adapt to changing screen geometry
You want to animate or style widgets based on the real corner radius
avoid_when: You only need a generic rounded corner value
You’re targeting only web or desktop where screen corners are irrelevant
strengths: Accurate per‑corner data on modern Android and iOS
Live stream of radius changes for multi‑screen devices
No external dependencies beyond Flutter SDK
weaknesses: Requires native platform code, so not usable on web/desktop
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, run flutter pub get. No special permissions or build_runner needed.
